snippet.title: Gundam Rogue Orbit - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT launches on March 5th, 2027!
  
Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #gundam
